name: Roasted PR Review
prompt:
A pull request was just labeled `roast-me`. Review it.

The GitHub event payload is available in the run context: use `repository.full_name` as the repo and `pull_request.number` as the PR number.

1. Clone the repository and check out the exact PR head SHA (`pull_request.head.sha`). Do not review a moving target — record the SHA now and use it for the whole run.
2. Read the full PR context: title, description, `gh pr diff`, the changed-file list, existing review comments, and CI status.
3. Run `/codereview-roasted` over the diff. Follow that skill exactly — including the GROUNDING rules: read files from the checkout before claiming anything is missing, and verify every line number you cite with `sed -n 'X,Yp' <file>` before attaching an inline comment.
4. Post the review to the PR using the `github-pr-review` skill: inline comments on the specific lines, and the Taste Rating, Verdict, Key Insight, and [RISK ASSESSMENT] sections in the review body.
5. Post the review as a COMMENT event, never APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES — a human makes the merge call.

Before posting, re-check that the PR is still open and `pull_request.head.sha` is unchanged. If either has changed, skip posting and say so instead — a review of a stale SHA is worse than no review.

Do not modify any code. Do not push commits. Do not merge. Review only.
